title: Principled MAP estimation for inverse problems: bridging the gap between convergence and performance
title_zh: principled MAP估计法用于逆问题：弥合收敛与性能之间的差距

paragraphs.en: Pretrained denoisers provide a powerful way to incorporate image priors into restoration algorithms. Plug-and-Play and RED approaches exploit fixed-noise-level denoisers within first-order optimization schemes, with convergence guarantees, but often struggle to achieve high-quality reconstruction on severely ill-posed inverse problems. In contrast, recent state-of-the-art approaches leverage denoisers derived from flow- or diffusion-based generative models and evaluate them along a sequence of decreasing noise levels. While these methods achieve strong empirical performance, their convergence theory remains limited. In this paper, we bridge this gap by specifically designing an algorithm that combines denoisers at decreasing noise levels with a schedule tailored to ensure convergence. From a Bayesian perspective, we prove that our method converges to a Maximum a Posteriori (MAP) estimate, under suitable assumptions. Subsequently, we apply our method to various ill-posed inverse problems and show that it surpasses convergent methods while competing with state-of-the-art empirical ones.
paragraphs.zh: 预训练的降噪器为将图像先验知识融入恢复算法提供了一种强大的方法。 Plug-and-Play 和 RED 方法在第一阶优化方案中利用固定噪声水平的降噪器，并具备收敛性保证，但在处理严重不适定的逆问题时，往往难以实现高质量的重建。 相比之下，近期的先进方法则利用基于流或扩散的生成模型衍生出的降噪器，并沿着一系列逐渐降低的噪声水平对其进行评估。 尽管这些方法在实证表现上十分出色，但其收敛性理论仍显不足。 在本文中，我们通过专门设计一种算法来弥合这一差距：该算法将不同噪声水平的降噪器与经过精心设计的调度方案相结合，以确保收敛性。 从贝叶斯视角来看，我们在适当假设下证明了该方法能够收敛到最大后验（MAP）估计值。 随后，我们将该方法应用于多种不适定的逆问题，并证明其不仅超越了具备收敛性的传统方法，在实证表现上也与当前最先进的技术相媲美。

paragraphs.en: Early works relied on hand-crafted regularizers, such as the ℓ 1 \ell_{1} -norm, total-variation, and wavelet sparsity ( Rudin et al., 1992 ; Donoho and Johnstone, 1998 ; Scherzer et al., 2009 ) . For these choices of g g , ( 1 ) can easily be solved with classical gradient-descent or proximal algorithms. However, the resulting reconstruction x ^ \hat{x} often lacks perceptual quality due to the limited expressiveness of the regularization. In order to integrate more complex prior information about clean images, later approaches considered the use of a pretrained denoiser D σ D_{\sigma} with fixed noise level σ \sigma within optimization schemes, as an implicit regularizer. Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods ( Venkatakrishnan et al., 2013 ; Chan et al., 2016 ) replaced the proximal operator by such a denoiser, which significantly improved perceptual quality of the reconstruction on simple inverse problems such as denoising and deblurring. Under certain conditions on the denoiser, PnP methods can be proven to converge, but the limit of the resulting sequence generally cannot be characterized ( Ryu et al., 2019 ; Pesquet et al., 2021 ; Hurault et al., 2022 ; Hurault, 2023 ) . Regularization by Denoising (RED, Romano et al. 2017 ) partially bridges the gap between gradient based methods and PnP ones, by using a specific regularizer: g ⁡ ( x ) = μ ​ x ⊤ ​ ( x − D σ ​ ( x ) ) g(x)=\mu x^{\top}(x-D_{\sigma}(x)) . When D σ D_{\sigma} is locally homogeneous and has symmetric Jacobian, ∇ g ​ ( x ) = μ ⁡ ( x − D σ ​ ( x ) ) \nabla g(x)=\mu(x-D_{\sigma}(x)) , and gradient descent on ( 1 ) leads to Algorithm 1 ; however these conditions rarely hold for trained denoisers ( Reehorst and Schniter, 2019 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 早期的工作依赖于人工设计的正则化项，例如 ℓ₁-范数、全变分和小波稀疏性（Rudin 等人，1992；Donoho 和 Johnstone，1998；Scherzer 等人，2009）。 对于这些 g 的选择，(1) 可以通过经典的梯度下降或近端算法轻松求解。 然而，由于正则化的表达能力有限，所得到的重建结果 x̂ 通常缺乏感知质量。 为了整合关于干净图像的更复杂先验信息，后续的方法在优化方案中考虑使用一个预训练的降噪器 Dσ（噪声水平 σ 固定），将其作为一种隐式正则化项。 “即插即用”（PnP）方法（Venkatakrishnan 等人，2013；Chan 等人，2016）用这样的降噪器替代了近端算子，从而显著提升了在降噪和去模糊等简单逆问题中的重建感知质量。 在满足对降噪器的某些条件下，可以证明 PnP 方法是收敛的，但所得序列的极限通常无法明确描述（Ryu 等人，2019；Pesquet 等人，2021；Hurault 等人，2022；Hurault，2023）。 “通过降噪的正则化”（RED，Romano 等人，2017）方法通过使用一个特定的正则化项 g(x) = μx⊤(x − Dσ(x))，部分弥合了基于梯度的方法与 PnP 方法之间的差距。 当 Dσ 是局部齐次且具有对称雅可比矩阵时，即 ∇g(x) = μ(x − Dσ(x))，对 (1) 进行梯度下降会导出算法 1；然而，这些条件在训练好的降噪器中很少成立（Reehorst 和 Schniter，2019）。

paragraphs.en: Despite appealing guarantees, the performance of such methods remains limited on challenging inverse problems such as inpainting or super-resolution. To address this limitation, state-of-the-art algorithms use off-the-shelf diffusion- or flow-based generative models ( Song et al., 2020 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Albergo and Vanden-Eijnden, 2023 ) . Most of these algorithms have two main ingredients: (approximate) MMSE denoisers D σ D_{\sigma} accross all noise levels σ \sigma , along with an annealed noise schedule with decreasing σ \sigma across iterations ( Chung et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Among them, we are specifically interested in optimization-based methods which are explicit adaptations of PnP or RED schemes ( Zhu et al., 2023 ; Renaud et al., 2024 ; Martin et al., 2025 ; Pourya et al., 2026 ) . While these methods achieve impressive results on highly ill-posed inverse problems, their theoretical understanding lags behind: since the denoiser changes at each iteration, so does the underlying objective, and analyses developed for classical PnP methods no longer hold. Apart from the denoising case A = Id \mathrm{A}=\mathrm{Id} ( Pesme et al., 2025 ) , the convergence of annealed schemes and the characterization of their limit remain open questions.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这些方法提供了诱人的保证，但在修复或超分辨率等具有挑战性的逆问题中，其性能仍然有限。 为了解决这一局限性，当前最先进的算法采用了现成的基于扩散或流模型的生成模型（Song et al., 2020 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Albergo and Vanden-Eijnden, 2023）。 这些算法大多包含两个主要成分：适用于所有噪声水平 σ 的（近似）MMSE 去噪器 D σ D_{\sigma}，以及一个在迭代过程中逐渐降低 σ 的退火噪声调度（Chung et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024）。 其中，我们特别关注基于优化的方法，这些方法是对 PnP 或 RED 方案的明确改编（Zhu et al., 2023 ; Renaud et al., 2024 ; Martin et al., 2025 ; Pourya et al., 2026）。 尽管这些方法在高度病态的逆问题上取得了令人印象深刻的结果，但对其理论理解却相对滞后：由于去噪器在每次迭代中都会变化，其底层的优化目标也随之改变，因此为经典 PnP 方法开发的分析已不再适用。 除了去噪情况 A = Id \mathrm{A}=\mathrm{Id}（Pesme et al., 2025）之外，退火方案的收敛性及其极限特征的描述仍然是未解的问题。

paragraphs.en: Our work belongs to the line of work that seeks to build interpretable and convergent inverse problems solvers based on generative models ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Pesme et al., 2025 ) . Many generative-based methods rely on empirical design choices, in particular empirical noise schedules. Instead, we build an algorithm, interpretable as an annealed RED scheme ( Algorithm 2 ), to explicitly solve the maximum a posteriori (MAP) problem and derive its schedules to guarantee convergence. While f f is explicit, the negative log-prior − log ⁡ p -\log p is unknown. Pesme et al. (2025) showed how MMSE denoisers, which diffusion and flow matching models approximate, can be leveraged to solve MAP denoising problems ( A = Id \mathrm{A}=\mathrm{Id} ), i.e. to compute the prox of − log ⁡ p -\log p : their MMSE Averaging scheme provably converges. paragraphs.en: We introduce Generalized Annealed MMSE Averaging (GAMMA), a generic inverse problem solver using MMSE denoisers evaluated at decreasing noise levels. It extends the MMSE Averaging algorithm of Pesme et al. (2025) , which is restricted to MAP denoising. It also connects to existing methods such as annealed version of RED ( Algorithm 2 ), annealed-SNORE ( Renaud et al., 2024 ) and PnP-Flow ( Martin et al., 2025 ) , which do not possess convergence guarantees.

paragraphs.en: We present Generalized Annealed MMSE Averaging (GAMMA), a new algorithm based on MMSE denoisers. It generalizes MMSE Averaging to any inverse problems (beyond denoising / prox computation), while preserving its convergence guarantees. Compared to MMSE Averaging, it replaces the fixed term y y by a gradient descent step on a regularized version of the datafit f f .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了广义退火 MMSE 平均法（GAMMA），这是一种基于 MMSE 去噪器的新算法。 它将 MMSE 平均法推广到任何逆问题（不仅限于去噪/近端计算），同时保留了其收敛性保证。 与 MMSE 平均法相比，它用对正则化数据拟合函数 f f 的梯度下降步替代了固定项 y y。

sents.en: We present Generalized Annealed MMSE Averaging (GAMMA), a new algorithm based on MMSE denoisers.

sents.en: It generalizes MMSE Averaging to any inverse problems (beyond denoising / prox computation), while preserving its convergence guarantees.
sents.zh: 它将 MMSE 平均法推广到任何逆问题（不仅限于去噪/近端计算），同时保留了其收敛性保证。

sents.en: Compared to MMSE Averaging, it replaces the fixed term y y by a gradient descent step on a regularized version of the datafit f f .

paragraphs.en: Most existing convergence analyses of PnP and RED algorithms consider a fixed noise level and rely on structural assumptions on the denoiser, such as boundedness, non-expansivity, or suitable Jacobian properties ( Ryu et al., 2019 ; Reehorst and Schniter, 2019 ; Terris et al., 2020 ; Hurault, 2023 ) . Recent generative-model-based methods instead use denoisers at decreasing noise levels ( Zhu et al., 2023 ; Mardani et al., 2024 ; Martin et al., 2025 ; Pourya et al., 2026 ) , for which the implicit regularization changes throughout the iterations and the fixed-noise theory does not readily apply. Our construction is specifically designed for this decreasing-noise setting, with a schedule that preserves a variational interpretation and enables convergence analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数现有的 PnP 和 RED 算法的收敛性分析都考虑了固定的噪声水平，并依赖于对去噪器的结构性假设，例如有界性、非扩张性或合适的雅可比矩阵性质（Ryu 等，2019；Reehorst 和 Schniter，2019；Terris 等，2020；Hurault，2023）。 相比之下，近期基于生成模型的方法则使用噪声水平逐渐降低的去噪器（Zhu 等，2023；Mardani 等，2024；Martin 等，2025；Pourya 等，2026），在这种情况下，隐式正则化在整个迭代过程中会发生变化，因此固定噪声理论无法直接适用。 我们的构建方法专门针对这种噪声逐渐降低的场景而设计，其调度方案既保留了变分解释，也支持收敛性分析。

paragraphs.en: When the denoiser is learned optimally to be the MMSE denoiser, one can then leverage ( 4 ) to interpret an iteration of PnP-FLow as two consecutive gradient steps, rather than as a single gradient step as in GAMMA. paragraphs.en: Approximate Proximal Gradient Descent. Finally, as MMSE Averaging allows approximate computation of the proximal operator of − τ ​ log ⁡ p -\tau\log p , Pesme et al. (2025, Algorithm 1) proposed to use this approximation in a proximal gradient descent scheme for inverse problems with generic data-fidelity f f . Approx-PGD inherits two limitations of inexact proximal algorithms: the inner loop to approximate the proximal operator requires increasingly many iterations † † at iteration k k , it requires 𝒪 ⁡ ( k 1 + η ) \mathcal{O}(k^{1+\eta}) with η > 0 \eta>0 making the algorithm computationally expensive, and the convergence results apply to objective values F ⁡ ( x k ) F(x_{k}) without ensuring the convergence of the iterates themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 近似邻近梯度下降法。 最后，由于 MMSE Averaging 允许对 − τ ​ log ⁡ p -\tau\log p 的邻近算子进行近似计算，Pesme 等人 (2025, 算法 1) 提出在具有通用数据保真度 f f 的反问题中，于邻近梯度下降方案中使用这种近似方法。 Approx-PGD 继承了不精确邻近算法的两个局限性：用于近似邻近算子的内循环需要越来越多的迭代次数 † † 在第 k k 次迭代时，其复杂度为 𝒪 ⁡ ( k 1 + η ) \mathcal{O}(k^{1+\eta})，其中 η > 0 \eta>0，这使得算法计算成本高昂；此外，收敛性结果仅适用于目标函数值 F ⁡ ( x k ) F(x_{k})，并未确保迭代点本身的收敛性。

paragraphs.en: Conceptually, our framework provides a common perspective on MMSE Averaging, an annealed variant of RED, and SNORE, while also revealing a close connection with PnP-Flow. In addition to circumventing the limitations of Approx-PGD described above, our approach gives competitive results on imaging inverse problems, hence bridging the gap between the theory developed in Pesme et al. (2025) and algorithms used in practice.
paragraphs.zh: 从概念上讲，我们的框架为 MMSE Averaging、RED 的一种退火变体以及 SNORE 提供了一个共同的视角，同时揭示了它们与 PnP-Flow 之间的紧密联系。除了规避上述 Approx-PGD 的局限性外，我们的方法在成像反问题上也取得了具有竞争力的结果，从而弥合了 Pesme 等人（2025）所发展的理论与实际使用的算法之间的差距。

paragraphs.en: From an optimization viewpoint, GAMMA is closely related to continuation methods ( Allgower and Georg, 2012 ) : it performs gradient steps on smoothed objectives F σ k F_{\sigma_{k}} which converge pointwise to F F as σ k → 0 \sigma_{k}\to 0 . Unlike classical continuation, it takes a single step on each smoothing level instead of solving each intermediate problem. Our construction combines two regularization mechanisms. First, a vanishing Tikhonov term is added to the data-fidelity, a classical technique in convex optimization and inverse problems whose convergence properties have been studied, e.g., by Attouch and László (2024) . Second, the prior is Gaussian-smoothed inside the logarithm, through − log ⁡ p σ -\log p_{\sigma} . This differs from standard Gaussian smoothing ( Nesterov and Spokoiny, 2017 ) which would be applied directly to the objective function (hence to − log ⁡ p -\log p ). This form arises naturally from MMSE denoisers and requires a specific analysis as σ → 0 \sigma\to 0 .
paragraphs.zh: 从优化角度来看，GAMMA 与延拓方法（Allgower 和 Georg，2012）密切相关：它在平滑后的目标函数 Fσk F_{\sigma_{k}} 上执行梯度步长，当 σk→0 \sigma_{k}\to 0 时，这些步长逐点收敛于 F。 与经典延拓方法不同，它不会求解每个中间问题，而是在每个平滑层级上仅执行单一步长。 我们的构造结合了两种正则化机制。 首先，在数据保真项中加入一个趋于零的 Tikhonov 项，这是凸优化和反问题中的经典技术，其收敛性质已被研究，例如 Attouch 和 László（2024）的研究。 其次，先验项在对数内部通过 −log pσ -\log p_{\sigma} 进行了高斯平滑处理。 这与标准的高斯平滑方法（Nesterov 和 Spokoiny，2017）不同，后者会直接应用于目标函数（因此也应用于 −log p -\log p）。 这种形式自然源于 MMSE 去噪器，并在 σ→0 \sigma\to 0 时需要特定的分析。

paragraphs.en: While H 1 on the data-fidelity term f f is typically satisfied in standard inverse problems, the log-concavity assumption on the prior p p in H 2 is more restrictive. Nevertheless, log-concavity provides a natural and tractable setting for studying decreasing-noise schemes and is a standard simplifying assumption in theoretical analyses of annealed methods ( Dalalyan, 2017 ; Brosse et al., 2018 ; Durmus et al., 2019 ) . It is also the setting adopted by Pesme et al. (2025) to establish convergence guarantees for MMSE Averaging.

(2025, Proposition 4) , motivates our method: F σ F_{\sigma} has more favorable optimization properties than F F , suggesting that minimizing F σ F_{\sigma} may be more tractable than minimizing F F directly. paragraphs.en: Approx-PGD, as noted in Vert et al. (2026) , tends to produce cartoon-like images, an effect mitigated by early stopping. Despite tuning the number of steps, it does not perform satisfactorily beyond denoising. This is consistent with the original paper ( Pesme et al., 2025 ) , which reports no numerical results. GAMMA , in its noiseless version, performs well on deblurring and random inpainting, substantially improving over Approx-PGD. Yet, on more generative tasks (super-resolution and mask inpainting), it shows a similar collapse toward cartoon-like images, with visible artefacts. We attribute it to the absence of early stopping, as we use the same fixed iteration budget for the noiseless and renoised variants. Renoised-GAMMA is much closer to the PnP-Flow baseline across all tasks, including generative ones: the qualitative results are convincing and LPIPS matches that of PnP-Flow. It remains below PnP-Flow in PSNR, which we potentially attribute to the annealed noise schedule σ k \sigma_{k} not reaching the observation noise level σ y = 0.05 \sigma_{y}=0.05 within the prescribed iteration budget, so the observation noise is not fully removed. Finally, the relaxed GAMMA variant shows that, by forcing the noise schedule to reach 0 0 within a prescribed number of steps, our algorithm matches the performance of PnP-Flow. Overall, these results highlight the versatility of our approach and the importance of carefully designed noise schedules. This contrasts with other renoised annealed RED approaches such as SNORE ( Renaud et al., 2024 ) : although SNORE admits convergence guarantees in the fixed-noise setting, its annealed variant provides neither comparable guarantees nor principled guidance for choosing the noise schedule, and reports no results on challenging generative inverse problems such as super-resolution or box inpainting. Our experiments also highlight the importance of renoising in generative inverse problems. Our theory incorporates this step, ubiquitous in generative-based methods, while remaining within the MAP framework.
paragraphs.zh: 如 Vert 等人（2026）所指出的，Approx-PGD 倾向于生成卡通风格的图像，而提前停止可以缓解这一效应。 （2026）指出，Approx-PGD 倾向于生成卡通风格的图像，而提前停止可以缓解这一效应。 尽管调整了迭代步数，但它在去噪之外的任务上表现并不理想。 这与原始论文（Pesme 等人，2025）的结论一致，该论文并未报告任何数值结果。 GAMMA 在其无噪声版本中，在去模糊和随机补全任务上表现良好，显著优于 Approx-PGD。 然而，在更具生成性的任务（超分辨率和掩码补全）中，它同样表现出向卡通风格图像坍缩的趋势，并伴随可见的伪影。 我们认为这是因为没有采用提前停止策略，因为我们在无噪声和重新加噪变体中使用了相同的固定迭代预算。 Renoised-GAMMA 在所有任务（包括生成性任务）中都更接近 PnP-Flow 基线：其定性结果令人信服，且 LPIPS 指标与 PnP-Flow 一致。 它在 PSNR 上仍低于 PnP-Flow，我们推测这可能是由于退火噪声调度 σ_k 在预设的迭代预算内未能达到观测噪声水平 σ_y = 0.05，因此观测噪声未被完全去除。 最后，经过放松处理的 GAMMA 变体表明，通过将噪声调度强制在预设步数内降至 0，我们的算法能够匹配 PnP-Flow 的性能。 总体而言，这些结果凸显了我们方法的灵活性以及精心设计噪声调度的重要性。 这与 SNORE（Renaud 等人，2024）等其他重新加噪的退火 RED 方法形成对比：尽管 SNORE 在固定噪声设定下具有收敛性保证，但其退火版本既没有提供可比较的保证，也没有为选择噪声调度提供理论指导，且未报告在超分辨率或框补全等具有挑战性的生成性逆问题上的结果。 我们的实验也凸显了重新加噪在生成性逆问题中的重要性。 我们的理论框架纳入了这一在基于生成的方法中普遍存在的步骤，同时仍保持在 MAP 框架内。

sents.en: Approx-PGD, as noted in Vert et al.
sents.zh: 如 Vert 等人（2026）所指出的，Approx-PGD 倾向于生成卡通风格的图像，而提前停止可以缓解这一效应。

sents.en: (2026) , tends to produce cartoon-like images, an effect mitigated by early stopping.
sents.zh: （2026）指出，Approx-PGD 倾向于生成卡通风格的图像，而提前停止可以缓解这一效应。

sents.en: Despite tuning the number of steps, it does not perform satisfactorily beyond denoising.
sents.zh: 尽管调整了迭代步数，但它在去噪之外的任务上表现并不理想。

sents.en: This is consistent with the original paper ( Pesme et al., 2025 ) , which reports no numerical results.
sents.zh: 这与原始论文（Pesme 等人，2025）的结论一致，该论文并未报告任何数值结果。

sents.en: GAMMA , in its noiseless version, performs well on deblurring and random inpainting, substantially improving over Approx-PGD.
sents.zh: GAMMA 在其无噪声版本中，在去模糊和随机补全任务上表现良好，显著优于 Approx-PGD。

sents.en: Yet, on more generative tasks (super-resolution and mask inpainting), it shows a similar collapse toward cartoon-like images, with visible artefacts.
sents.zh: 然而，在更具生成性的任务（超分辨率和掩码补全）中，它同样表现出向卡通风格图像坍缩的趋势，并伴随可见的伪影。

sents.en: We attribute it to the absence of early stopping, as we use the same fixed iteration budget for the noiseless and renoised variants.
sents.zh: 我们认为这是因为没有采用提前停止策略，因为我们在无噪声和重新加噪变体中使用了相同的固定迭代预算。

sents.en: Renoised-GAMMA is much closer to the PnP-Flow baseline across all tasks, including generative ones: the qualitative results are convincing and LPIPS matches that of PnP-Flow.
sents.zh: Renoised-GAMMA 在所有任务（包括生成性任务）中都更接近 PnP-Flow 基线：其定性结果令人信服，且 LPIPS 指标与 PnP-Flow 一致。

sents.en: It remains below PnP-Flow in PSNR, which we potentially attribute to the annealed noise schedule σ k \sigma_{k} not reaching the observation noise level σ y = 0.05 \sigma_{y}=0.05 within the prescribed iteration budget, so the observation noise is not fully removed.
sents.zh: 它在 PSNR 上仍低于 PnP-Flow，我们推测这可能是由于退火噪声调度 σ_k 在预设的迭代预算内未能达到观测噪声水平 σ_y = 0.05，因此观测噪声未被完全去除。

sents.en: Finally, the relaxed GAMMA variant shows that, by forcing the noise schedule to reach 0 0 within a prescribed number of steps, our algorithm matches the performance of PnP-Flow.
sents.zh: 最后，经过放松处理的 GAMMA 变体表明，通过将噪声调度强制在预设步数内降至 0，我们的算法能够匹配 PnP-Flow 的性能。

sents.en: Overall, these results highlight the versatility of our approach and the importance of carefully designed noise schedules.
sents.zh: 总体而言，这些结果凸显了我们方法的灵活性以及精心设计噪声调度的重要性。

sents.en: This contrasts with other renoised annealed RED approaches such as SNORE ( Renaud et al., 2024 ) : although SNORE admits convergence guarantees in the fixed-noise setting, its annealed variant provides neither comparable guarantees nor principled guidance for choosing the noise schedule, and reports no results on challenging generative inverse problems such as super-resolution or box inpainting.
sents.zh: 这与 SNORE（Renaud 等人，2024）等其他重新加噪的退火 RED 方法形成对比：尽管 SNORE 在固定噪声设定下具有收敛性保证，但其退火版本既没有提供可比较的保证，也没有为选择噪声调度提供理论指导，且未报告在超分辨率或框补全等具有挑战性的生成性逆问题上的结果。

sents.en: Our experiments also highlight the importance of renoising in generative inverse problems.
sents.zh: 我们的实验也凸显了重新加噪在生成性逆问题中的重要性。

sents.en: Our theory incorporates this step, ubiquitous in generative-based methods, while remaining within the MAP framework.
sents.zh: 我们的理论框架纳入了这一在基于生成的方法中普遍存在的步骤，同时仍保持在 MAP 框架内。

paragraphs.en: We introduced GAMMA, a convergent annealed RED-type method, with an optional renoising mechanism, whose noise and regularization schedules are explicitly designed to guarantee convergence to a MAP solution. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first approach to bridge the gap between provably convergent denoiser-based MAP methods, such as Pesme et al. (2025) , and recent generative restoration methods, which typically rely on annealing and renoising without comparable guarantees. Our experiments show that this gap can be substantially narrowed with the renoised variant, achieving competitive reconstruction quality compared to recent non-convergent generative methods. When the constraints imposed by the theory are relaxed, the method reaches comparable performance, suggesting that the remaining gap is mainly due to the constraints on the current schedules. Future work will focus on relaxing the log-concavity assumption and extending the convergence analysis of the stochastic renoised scheme to less restrictive noise schedules.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 GAMMA，这是一种收敛退火型 RED 方法，带有可选的重噪声机制，其噪声和正则化调度经过明确设计，以确保收敛到 MAP 解。 据我们所知，这是首个弥合以下两类方法之间差距的方法：一类是具备可证明收敛性的去噪器 기반 MAP 方法（例如 Pesme 等人（2025）的研究），另一类是近期依赖退火和重噪声但缺乏类似保证的生成式恢复方法。 （2025）的研究，以及近期依赖退火和重噪声但缺乏类似保证的生成式恢复方法。 我们的实验表明，通过采用重噪声变体，这一差距可以显著缩小，其重建质量可与近期的非收敛生成式方法相媲美。 当放宽理论所施加的约束时，该方法可达到相当的性能水平，这表明剩余的差距主要源于当前调度方案中的约束条件。 未来的工作将聚焦于放宽对数凹性假设，并将随机重噪声方案的收敛分析扩展到限制较少的噪声调度方案中。
